column1: # The programs Stagepack ships beside the viewer, which it runs as separate processes, unmodified (see
# "Licences" in the README). build/programs.sh dist/<os> checks a build against this list and adds each
# licence text to the build's THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt. ${NAME} is a value from build/versions.env.
# folder: the program's folder in dist/<os> and in the install folder
# licence file: its licence text, relative to dist/<os> (the same on Linux and Windows)
# sources: the source archives, separated by spaces, each mirrored in Stagepack's release assets: a URL (the
#   asset has its file name), NAME=URL (the asset is called NAME), or a NAME alone for an archive the release
#   makes itself (build/fetch.sh ffmpeg-libraries). The names are those build/fetch.sh gives them in .cache/dl.

column3: MIT, and the licences of the parts it bundles (in its LICENSE)
BSD-3-Clause (Chromium), and the licences of its third-party parts, among them LGPL-2.1-or-later (its ffmpeg)
GPL-3.0-or-later (built with --enable-gpl --enable-version3; links libx264 and the other libraries in build/ffmpeg-sources.tsv)
